svg.title: At 178 NOAA gauges, both engines were given NOAA's own constants. Each dot is one gauge's mean time error of high and low water against NOAA's published predictions, on a log scale in minutes. OTC's predictor: median 0.26 min, every gauge under 2.3 min. The other engine: median 2.85 min, up to 17.4 min.
